angle: DL/EDGE: Run-the-Hoop Hoop G vs NFL pressure rate, reframed as a lateral-force (change-of-direction) marker rather than corner bend; baseline = log pick + weight + EDGE share + NGS athleticism + games per season + official 10-yd and 3-cone (imputed with a flag; observed-only tests reported)
metric_name: Hoop G: peak sideways acceleration held for 0.5 s while rounding the hoops (g, z within Combine year), corrected for one-run reliability 0.41
headline_number: 0.6 extra pressures per 450-rush season per sd, 90% [-0.4, 1.7] (Bayesian beta-binomial, skeptical prior, n=90); 2x prior 1.5 [0.0, 3.1], wide 2.0 [0.1, 4.0]. Out of class: nested R2 change -0.026 [-0.286, 0.185] (n=63), observed-10-yd baseline -0.002 [-0.645, 0.278] (n=49); held-out log predictive density +1.36 +/- 0.50 nats (n=90, positive in 3 of 3 classes, not fully nested).
what_changed_from_previous: Revision of round_06/cand_1 applying all four judges. Robinson vs McGuire wrong, C. Johnson>Jean-Baptiste right) plus all 14 pairs with a shuffled-bend null (8 of 14, p=0.33); cost-of-collection line (7.5 s per run); injuries/snap-role limitation; 7-of-8 moved to the appendix and labelled not evidence. Data science: baseline text matches the fitted model; nested R2 on observed 10-yd (n=49) and 3-cone (n=27) only; MCMC headline under three prior scales; held-out log predictive density as a proper scoring rule; 3-cone row dropped from Fig 2; 7-of-8 given a bootstrap interval, permutation null and the 2025-only count. Writeup: 60-word bold lede; first table carries both n values and all out-of-class rows; per-class and method detail moved to the appendix; tracking check merged into the mechanism section/limitations; 'first trait scouts write down' softened. Viz: Fig 1 rebuilt compact (1410 px vs 2100) with the null in the title, cohort-mean reference line, and a 79-DL drill-vs-game scatter replacing the strips; old Fig 3 scatter dropped; new Fig 3 is dot-and-interval (80/95%) for priors, R2 and log score with the axis covering all intervals; Fig 4 calls sorted by residual, rate and rushes beside names, axis uncapped, arrows only when the 80% interval excludes the forecast; takeaway captions throughout. check.py 1,593 words, 4 figures + 4 tables.
open_risks: The log-score gain is positive but not fully nested (hoop and prior scale chosen on all classes); judges may read it as a soft contradiction of the null R2 test.
Prior dependence remains: the planning number is the smallest of three prior scales (2x and wide priors give 1.5 and 2.0).
Reframing as 'lateral force' is supported only by negative mechanism tests; what the hoop actually captures is unknown without film.
Head-to-head tie-break record is 8 of 14 with a 50% null (p=0.33): the actionable rule is unproven.
Alignment test uses sampled random snaps (about 20 per player) and per-snap pressure flags; intervals are wide.
